scope: local bpy 4.5.3 dynamic-library inventory, not proof Blender is universally unavailable

alternativeChecks.blenderGithubLatestRelease: gh api repos/blender/blender/releases/latest returned HTTP 404; not a claim that no official Blender distribution exists
alternativeChecks.bpy-headless: pip index versions: no matching distribution
alternativeChecks.containerRuntimes: docker/podman not found in executable search
alternativeChecks.wheelInspection: wheel-library-inventory.json; central-directory range reads only; no unrelated package installed
alternativeChecks.blockedHosts: No repeated attempts on previously blocked asset/download hosts

decision: Stop speculative dependency downloads. Require supported Blender installation with genuine OS dependencies, locally or on an explicitly authorized compatible runner. No fake libraries, paid cloud or account assumed.
